# name: The dancers before the lords; the death of Huncame and Vucub Came
# title: Xe opon puch cuꜭ ahauab
# fols: fols. 30r–31v
Xe opon puch cuꜭ ahauab, que mocho chic, chi qui xule la qui vach xe oponic; xqui quemelah quib, chi qui luc quib, chi qui pach quib; chi mayo quih, chi aꜩiac, quiꜩih vi chi meba qui vachibal xe oponic.

Ta xꜩonox cut qui huyubal, camac puch; xꜩonox nai puch qui chuch, qui cahau. “Apa quix pe vi?” xe vꜭhaxic. “Maba quetaon, at ahau. Maui xquetamah v vach ca chuch, ca cahau; ca oh chutic oc ta xe camic,” xa xeꜭha; maui naquila xqui biyh.

“Vꜩ bala. Chi ban ta ba ca cay; naqui chivah? Yvahil chi ca yao,” xe vꜭhaxic. “Maba ca cah; quiꜩih chi ca ca xibih quib,” xeꜭha chic chire ahau. “Mi xibih ivib, mix xobic; quix xahon oc. Are ta nabe chi xah ri quix puzu ta ivib; chi poroh ta curi vochoch; chi bana ronohel ri ivetaam. Coh cay tah, ca cah are vma ca ꜭux. Quix be tac oc rumal, ix meba; chi ca ya yvahil,” xe vꜭhax cut.

Ta xqui tiquiba cut qui bix, qui xahoh; ta xul cut ronohel ri Xibalba, xe pulic e cayel ronohel. Cut xqui xaho; xqui xah Cux, xqui xah Puhuy, xqui xah Yboy.

Xꜭha cu ahau chique: “Chi puzu ri nu ꜩy; chi caztah chi v vach ivumal,” xe vꜭhaxic. “Ve,” xeꜭha. Ta xqui puz ꜩy, xꜭaztai chi v vach; quiꜩih cu chi quicot ri ꜩy ta xꜭaztah v vach, chu zacbizala vhe ta xꜭaztah v vach.

Xꜭha cu ahau chique: “Chi poroh na ba vochoch,” xe vꜭhaxic chic. Ta xqui poroh cut rochoch ahau, e pulinac ahauab pa ha conohel; maui xecahic. Libah chi chic xcuꜩinizah; mana huzu zachic ri rochoch Huncame.

Xqui maihah cut conohel ahauab; xavi cu xere que xahouic, nim que quicotic. Xe vꜭhax chi cut rumal ahau: “Chi camizah na cu hun vinac, chi puzu, ma ta cu chi camic,” xe vꜭhax cut.

“Vꜩ bala,” xeꜭha. Ta xqui chap cut hun vinac; cate xqui puzu, xqui poꜫoh cu acanoc vꜭux ri hun vinac; xqui coloba cut chi qui vach ahauab. Xqui maiha chi cut Huncame, Vvcub Came; libah chi cut xꜭazta chi v vach ri hun vinac cumal; nim chi quicot vꜭux ta xꜭaztah v vach.

Xqui maihah cut ahauab: “Chi puzu chi na cu ivib, chi quil tah; quiꜩih cu raih ca ꜭux ri i xahoh,” xeꜭha chi cu ahauab. “Vꜩ bala, at ahau,” xeꜭha cut.

Cate puch xqui puz quib. Are cu xpuz ri Xhunahpu rumal Xbalanque; huhunal cu xperepoxic racan vcab, xel vholom, xcole aponoc chi nah; xcotix vloc vꜭux, xcheque chuvach ꜩalic, que cabar curi ronohel rahaual Xibalba. Chi cay xa cu hun chi ca xahouilabic ri Xbalanque. “Ca valih oc!” xꜭha cut. Libah chi cut xꜭaztah v vach. Nim que quicotic. Xavi quehe que quicot ahauab; xavi are que banouic ca quicot qui ꜭux Huncame, Vvcub Came, queheri are que xahouic ca qui nao.

Cate puch v rainic, v malinic pu qui ꜭux ahauab chire qui xahoh Xhunahpu, Xbalanque, ta xel cu qui ꜩih Huncame, Vvcub Came: “Chi bana chique; coh i puzu,” xeꜭha cut. “Hunal tah coh i puzu,” xecha cut Huncame, Vvcub Came chique ri Xhunahpu, Xbalanque.

“Vꜩ bala; chi ꜭaztah i vach. Ma pa ix ꜭo cam? Oh pu quicotirizai ive, ix pu rahaual ival i ꜭahol,” xeꜭha cut chique ahauab.

Are cu nabe xpuz ri qui vholom ahau, Huncame vbi, rahaual Xibalba. Caminac chi cut Huncame, ta xchap chic Vvcub Came; maui xꜭaztah chi qui vach.

Cate pu quelic Xibalba chi cacan, are xquil ri ahauab xe camic, e xaraxoh chubic, e pu xaraxoxinac qui cabichal; xa cu cahizabal qui vach xbanic. Huzuc xucamibeh ri hun ahau; mana xqui ꜭaztah chi v vach.

Are cu ri hun ahau xelah na, xoc na chi qui vach ri e xahol; maui xuculu, ma pu xurico. “Tocob nu vach,” xꜭha, ta xu na rib.

Xe quiz cu bec ronohel cal qui ꜭahol pa nima zivan; xa hun xqui balih vi quib pa nima xolobachan. Chiri cut e tubul vi, ta xe culun cut; maui ahilan chi zanic hucaly vla que pa zivan. Queheri xe beyox vloc, ta xe ul cut, xqui xul qui ya chi quib conohel; xe ul elahoc, xe ul pu ococ. Quehe cut que chacatahic rahaual Xibalba, xa maihabal, xa pu qui halvachibal quib ta xqui bano.
